description.value: A multimodal MRI study examined whether glucose-induced changes in hypothalamic CBF were related to glucose-induced changes in left ventral striatal food-cue reactivity in healthy individuals.

spans.text: We combined two neuroimaging modalities, ASL and BOLD-fMRI, and leveraged the unique advantages of both techniques to study how glucose-induced changes in hypothalamic activity are related to changes in food-cue reactivity within brain reward areas.

value: we predicted that glucose-induced reductions in hypothalamic activity would correlate with reductions in food-cue reactivity within brain areas implicated in reward processing.
